scope: Independent retrospective assistant content judgments for the 31 raw author occurrences in stems-b.json, with authored keys, feedback, arm, downstream results, original capture, and sibling assessments withheld. These are not human-expert ground truth and do not establish general production accuracy. Ordinary curriculum conventions and the supplied goal/source context are accepted; arbitrary unstated case facts are not supplied. unique means one warranted listed answer; multiple_supported means multiple warranted listed answers; zero_supported means no listed answer follows; ambiguous identifies a material interpretation or conflicting-premise problem. For ambiguous items, any supported_choices entry is defensible only under the interpretation or explicit answer qualification described in reason, and is not a claim of an unconditionally unique answer. Calculations under conflicting or additional premises are explicitly labeled rather than silently adopted.
